notes.title: Ultimate Edition Available Now With DLC Fan Pack Back!
notes.notes:
YinYang Street Ultimate Edition is available now with bug fixes and new contents! Chinese New Year is just around the corner. Help Li Minglai find his missing wife and daughter!


Ultimate Edition Patch Notes:
1. The experience of the 3D ball mini game in final chapter is improved.
2. Memories of battlefield are added to final chapter.
3. Flashbacks are added to final chapter.
4. The problem that the television programme cannot be played on some devices is fixed. (Skip button is added as well. Skip the television programme if it still cannot be played.)
5. The problem that the tutorial about adding oil to Dementor might not pop up is fixed.
6. The mechanism of Dementor in some scenes is changed to avoid any possible bug.
7. The range where Dementor can interact with objects is enlarged.
8. The bug about judging cards in Changle Lane is fixed.


Ultimate Trailer:
[previewyoutube=saDJoC-7kl8;full][/previewyoutube]

Celebrating the release of Ultimate Edition, DLC Fan Pack, which served as launch month bonus previously, is back and free for everyone!

notes.title: Halloween 2023 Update & Discount
notes.notes:
Halloween Night should be a night filled with shocks and screams. And nothing can be scarier than playing horror games at this time.
YinYang Street now gets an update and a 25% discount. Grab this game before the sale ends on November 2 (PT)!

Halloween 2023 Patch Notes:
1. Two previous difficulty modes has merged into one. The overall difficulty of this game is reduced significantly.
2. Some achievements can be unlocked more easily now.
3. Steam cloud is supported now.

notes.title: V1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. Hint for playthrough is added.
2. Hint for mini games is added.
3. The rate of getting high-point cards in Changle Lane is increased.
4. The problem that player can still open cards while comparing cards is fixed.
5. The amount of Knife Coins player can get in Chapter 4 is increased.
6. Some known display errors are fixed.

notes.title: V1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. The mask is now immune to YinYang Street ghost hand damage.
2. The refresh rate of YinYang Street ghost hand is reduced.
3. The problem that Crimson may pop up when player triggers the story in Tianma Village is fixed.
4. The refresh rate of Crimson in all scenes is reduced.
5. The rate of being teleported to the real world on YinYang Street is reduced.
6. The number of clicks required for activating the Requiem Towers is reduced.
7. The amount of currency player can get in YinYang Street mini games is increased.
8. Hint for Windowed Mode is added to the in-game settings interface.
9. Load / Save is added to the in-game settings interface.
10. Achievement “Is money all it takes?” can be unlocked more easily now.
11. The background music in Chapter 2 is improved.
12. Indoor hint is added to Chapter 2.
13. The problem that Wooden Fish interface displays incorrectly is fixed.
14. The mechanism of Mykunos is improved. Now player can wear it as long as the energy circle is not zero.
15. The problem that some pictures and words display incorrectly is fixed.

notes.title: V1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
1. The problem that Crimson sometimes pops up near the player is fixed.
2. The problem that achievement “Chess saint” cannot be unlocked is fixed.
3. The problem that some tie-dye floor tiles cannot be rolled is fixed.
4. The problem that currency icon on YinYang Street displays incorrectly is fixed.
5. The display of some scenes is improved.

notes.title: Full version will be released on 2023.08.30! Demo updated!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that the full version of YinYang Street will be released on 2023.08.30 with a 10% discount lasting for one week! This indie horror game will support English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese at launch!
[previewyoutube=zhCGujU6evM;full][/previewyoutube]

We updated Demo according to players’ feedback the other day. Compared to the one released in June, changes are as follows:
Two puzzle difficulties are added. The normal one is suitable for players who enjoy solving puzzles. The easy one is suitable for players who concentrate on plots.
Clue highlight system is added. Beat a special object in rhythm after finding it, all clues in sight will be highlighted automatically.
Voices are raised.
Bugs are fixed.

Your progress in Demo can be carried over to the full version. Add YinYang Street to your wishlist and follow us to know more!

notes.title: New Demo is available now! Full version will be released in late August!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, YinYang Street is participating in Steam Next Fest. New Demo is available now. Compared to the old one, changes are as follows:
Interface is improved. Notebook is removed from Bag, making it easier for you to read notes anytime.
Control is improved. Now you can hold left mouse button to keep moving.
Traditional Chinese and English are added.
Mandarin voices are added.
Bugs are fixed.

The development of YinYang Street is coming to the end. The full version is planned to be released in late August and published by Cube Game. Add YinYang Street to your wishlist and follow us to know more!
